description: The Credence Group is a holding company managing a strategic portfolio of industry players across real estate, private lending, business acquisition, advisory and consulting services.
body:
Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common questions about The Credence Group.

The Credence Group is a diversified holding company with seven subsidiaries operating across real estate, finance, consulting, and media industries — all united by a commitment to integrity and excellence.

Our subsidiaries operate under an 'Integrated Verticality' model. Capital flows into real estate, which is built by our construction arm, financed by our lending division, and marketed by our media company — creating a complete value chain.

The Credence Group is headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, Canada.

For private equity and investment inquiries, please contact us at inquiries@credencegroup.com and our capital team will be in touch.

Yes! We are always looking for talented professionals across all subsidiaries. Visit our Careers page or send your resume to careers@credencegroup.com.

You can reach out via our Contact page or visit the individual subsidiary website from the Our Companies page. General inquiries can be sent to inquiries@credencegroup.com.

We operate across property acquisition, real estate brokerage, land development & construction, mortgage financing & private lending, private equity, business advisory & strategy, and marketing & content.
